name: Falls City Care Center
priceNote: Nebraska average for a nursing home (semi-private to private room). This facility does not publish its price.

inspections.title: Family or doctor not told about a change or injury
inspections.detail: Immediately tell the resident, the resident's doctor, and a family member of situations (injury/decline/room, etc.)  that affect the resident.

inspections.title: Not reassessed after a major change
inspections.detail: Assess the resident when there is a significant change in condition

inspections.title: Accident hazards or not enough supervision (falls, wandering)
inspections.detail: Ensure that a nursing home area is free from accident hazards and provides adequate supervision to prevent accidents.

inspections.title: Suspected abuse or neglect not reported on time
inspections.detail: Timely report suspected abuse, neglect, or theft and report the results of the investigation to proper authorities.
inspections.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation

inspections.title: Abuse allegation not investigated properly
inspections.detail: Respond appropriately to all alleged violations.
inspections.category: Freedom from Abuse, Neglect, and Exploitation

inspections.title: Not enough nursing staff
inspections.detail: Provide enough nursing staff every day to meet the needs of every resident; and have a licensed nurse in charge on each shift.

inspections.title: Resident choices not respected
inspections.detail: Honor the resident's right to and the facility must promote and facilitate resident self-determination through support of resident choice.

inspections.title: Medicare/Medicaid coverage notice not given
inspections.detail: Give residents notice of Medicaid/Medicare coverage and potential liability for services not covered.

inspections.title: Care plan incomplete
inspections.detail: Develop and implement a complete care plan that meets all the resident's needs, with timetables and actions that can be measured.

inspections.title: Care plan not updated on time
inspections.detail: Develop the complete care plan within 7 days of the comprehensive assessment; and prepared, reviewed, and revised by a team of health professionals.

inspections.title: Help with daily activities not provided
inspections.detail: Provide care and assistance to perform activities of daily living for any resident who is unable.

inspections.title: Infection control not followed
inspections.detail: Provide and implement an infection prevention and control program.

inspections.title: No registered nurse on duty as required
inspections.detail: Have a registered nurse on duty 8 hours a day; and  select a registered nurse to be the director of nurses on a full time basis.

inspections.title: Nurse aides missing required dementia and abuse training
inspections.detail: Ensure nurse aides have the skills they need to care for residents, and give nurse aides education in dementia care and abuse prevention.

inspections.title: Care not given as ordered
inspections.detail: Provide appropriate treatment and care according to orders, resident’s preferences and goals.

inspections.title: Infection control not followed
inspections.detail: Provide and implement an infection prevention and control program.

inspections.title: Poor ventilation
inspections.detail: Have enough outside ventilation via a window or mechanical ventilation, or both.

quality.label: Needing more help with daily activities

openings.note: Estimate: certified beds minus average daily residents (CMS). Certified beds are often more than the beds actually staffed. Call to confirm.

bio: For-profit nursing home in Falls City with 101 certified beds, part of Lantis Enterprises. Provides 24-hour skilled nursing care, long-term care, and short-term rehab.
